tests.command: docker image inspect --format 'ID={{.Id}} OS={{.Os}} ARCH={{.Architecture}} Created={{.Created}} Entrypoint={{json .Config.Entrypoint}} Cmd={{json .Config.Cmd}} User={{.Config.User}} Env={{json .Config.Env}} Labels={{json .Config.Labels}}' jenkins:2.440.1-alpine-loongarch64; docker run --rm --entrypoint sh jenkins:2.440.1-alpine-loongarch64 -lc 'cat /etc/alpine-release; apk info -e openjdk17-loongarch-jre-headless openjdk17-loongarch-jre; java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | grep -E "java.vm.name|java.version|os.arch"; java -version 2>&1; stat -c "%s %n" /usr/share/jenkins/jenkins.war /opt/jenkins-plugin-manager.jar; java -jar /usr/share/jenkins/jenkins.war --version 2>&1 | head -n 10'

docker rm -f jenkins-24401-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker run -d --name jenkins-24401-smoke -e JAVA_OPTS=-Djenkins.install.runSetupWizard=false jenkins:2.440.1-alpine-loongarch64; for i in $(seq 1 120); do code=$(docker exec jenkins-24401-smoke curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /tmp/login.html -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/login 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$code" = 200 ] || [ "$code" = 302 ]; then echo "HTTP_STATUS=$code after ${i}s inside Jenkins container"; docker exec jenkins-24401-smoke grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/login.html | head -n 1 || true; docker logs --tail 25 jenkins-24401-smoke 2>&1; exit 0; fi; state=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' jenkins-24401-smoke 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$state" = exited ]; then echo 'CONTAINER_EXITED'; docker logs --tail 80 jenkins-24401-smoke 2>&1; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; echo "HTTP_STATUS=$code after timeout"; docker logs --tail 80 jenkins-24401-smoke 2>&1; exit 1

dependencies.name: OpenJDK 17 LoongArch JRE packages
dependencies.source: Alpine v3.24 main and community LoongArch APK repositories
dependencies.verification: Both packages are installed; java reports OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM 17.0.17 on loongarch64.

dependencies.name: Jenkins WAR
dependencies.verification: Published Jenkins WAR checksum sidecar verified during acquisition and JENKINS_SHA checked during image build.

dependencies.name: Jenkins Plugin Installation Manager
dependencies.verification: Dockerfile checks the locally recorded SHA-256; no publisher checksum sidecar was available.

environment_assumptions: Docker daemon builds LoongArch64 layers natively
Host networking is available to reach Alpine package repositories
The build context is the Jenkins repository root
The alpine:latest tag is mutable; use a LoongArch64 Alpine image
Official WAR and Plugin Installation Manager artifact endpoints are reachable when preparing the build context
applicability.runtime: Runs Jenkins as user jenkins with ports 8080 and 50000 and JENKINS_HOME=/var/jenkins_home; verified with OpenJDK 17 Server VM and /login HTTP 200.
